opportunities.title: Autumn 2026 round of funding opportunities

amount.raw: Grants of up to £20,000 for individuals undertaking research travel and/or taking time to address specific research questions. Grants of up to £40,000 for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals and organisations seeking support to pursue research in British art.
opportunities.summary: The Autumn 2026 round of funding opportunities includes grants for individuals and organisations. Applications are now open and close on Monday 14 September.
